Install guide

Install Zoom on Omarchy

The official route: App launcher (preinstalled web app).

Reviewed 2026-10-18 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Zoom ships with Omarchy as a web app wrapping Zoom's web client. Start it from the app launcher (Super + Space). Zoom meeting links open straight into it.

Steps

  1. Zoom ships with Omarchy as a web app wrapping Zoom's web client.
  2. Start it from the app launcher (Super + Space). Zoom meeting links open straight into it.

Remove it, like any web app, with Remove > Web App in the Omarchy menu. [omarchy.org]

Source

From the official Omarchy manual, checked 2026-10-18. Zoom is not a package in the Omarchy repo, so it has no app page here; for repo apps use the apps list.
